description: Mail as case evidence: one bounded capture run of the six operational mailboxes the owner named (order-confirmation@, ship@, torontowh@, ap@, receiving@, qclabresults@; examples/case_mail_purchasing_capture_scope.live-check.json) into the versioned mail capture (integrations/capture_mail.py, Graph delta, GET-only reader; the one L1 mail store), the Portal, FM and Sage purchase-order and supplier rows read into the source mirror (GET-only), one projection build over the mirror and the capture whose stored Email.mentions_purchase_order links (ontology/mentions.py: the one identifier grammar, corroborated by two independent features, else a lead) say which purchase orders the reader's mail names (value-free survey per tier), then up to two purchase-order cases chosen from those links, strongest first, read from the capture index as the case reader; each case records Workbench findings citing body-pinned messages and byte-pinned attachments, every citation is re-read through the GET-only reader and checked against its hash, and a second reader without a mail grant must see withheld markers only. Fails when no mail reaches a case (evidence_label no-source-read). Counts only.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it (module tests are injected-transport: operating/tests/test_case_mail.py, operating/tests/test_case_mail_source_read.py, integrations/tests/test_capture_mail.py). Mail comes from the versioned mail capture (decision 2026-10-02-mail-and-mentions-store), no longer from the ingestion mail unit. The per-scan PO-mail survey (operating/po_mail_links.py, live check case.po_mail_links) is retired (ER-09): cases are picked from the projection's stored mention links, the one path plx.around and plx.object read. Mail must be a product source: the check passes only when at least one case read mail for the reader (evidence_label live-read, totals.cases >= 1, totals.messages_visible >= 1); a run that reads the PO relation and captured mail but builds no case with mail is evidence_label no-source-read and fails (run live-2026-10-02T02:02Z passed that way with 1 message and 0 cases). source_read says which input was missing (mail_messages, po_relation, cases_with_mail). A pass needs recorded findings: totals.findings_recorded >= 1 and totals.findings_not_recorded == 0 (a run with zero findings proves nothing; a finding refused at the write fails the check and totals.findings_refused names its refusal code, e.g. citation_unresolvable). Also required: the PO relation read, zero round-trip hash mismatches, zero mail outside the case mail scope and zero messages visible to the reader without a mail grant. Scope: the six operational mailboxes the owner named (2026-10-21: order-confirmation@, ship@, torontowh@, ap@, receiving@, qclabresults@; order@, ordersupport@, purchase-order@ and qcrequests@ had no mail in 30 days, sales@ and quotes@ do not exist), inbox only, all reported allowlisted in operating/case_mail_scope.json (owner decision 5be438765457: read all mailboxes, captures stay in the Workbench capture store, here {tmp}/state), over a 90-day first-round window, bounded at 1 delta page (50 messages) per folder (--capture-page-budget): a folder stopped by the budget is recorded incomplete (capture.reasons page_budget), never complete, and cases[*].mail_source.complete follows the capture's own completeness for the reader. survey records value-free counts over the reader's scoped capture index: messages_scanned, po_rows_scanned and po_scan_status (the Portal PO relation read), relations (status, rows and completeness of the PO, FM PO, Sage PO and supplier reads), po_links and links_by_tier (lead, corroborated, reviewed, contradicted) of the stored Email.mentions_purchase_order links whose message the reader may read, messages_with_po_links, pos_linked and po_links_withheld (marked links: counted, never shown or picked). Freight mail and a supplier's own number relate only through a PO number or a person's reviewed alias the message names, or its conversation; a number naming several orders is a lead to each. Which POs become cases is data (the stored links, reviewed then corroborated then lead, never a hardcoded case). projection.seconds measures the one build inside the 1800 s timeout; projection.links counts its links by tier. The allowlist itself (operating/case_mail_scope.json) is reported, not verified against the Exchange policy group. Cost: graph_requests_sent counts every Graph request of the run (capture GETs included: one message read and, for messages with attachments, one listing plus the file bytes, per captured message; at most 6 folders x 50 messages captured, then each indexed message re-read for the reader); directory lookups are shared within the run. Blocked: blocked_upstream names the Portal relation reads the Portal failed and, when Graph refused every in-scope mailbox with HTTP 403 or 401 (integrations/capture_mail.refused_parts, the one Graph part shape of capture_mail.graph_block), the refused call (mail.mailbox_lookup: the graph.user directory lookup; mail.folder_read: the mail reads) with error_code missing_permission and the missing application permission on 403 (User.Read.All; Mail.Read, which an Exchange application access policy may also scope out), or error_code unauthorized on 401, cause host_misconfiguration; a refusal of some mailboxes only is a capture gap (capture.reasons forbidden), never blocked. expect_blocked then requires one input read (source_read.inputs_read >= 1) and every input no part stopped read (source_read.unblocked_unread empty: mail when only the Portal is blocked, the PO relation when only mail is). Live 2026-10-17 on: every mailbox 403 authorization_request_denied on graph.user after the 2026-10-16 Entra app switch (later_ask graph-secret-account-a). People exclusion (integrations/people_exclusion.py, access record 64fca27acc88): excluded people's mailboxes and the messages they sent are refused by Entra object ID before any request and never stored or indexed; with the ID list (later_ask excluded-people-oids) absent the capture is blocked: blocked_upstream [{part mail.people_exclusion, source people-exclusion, error_code excluded_people_oids_absent, cause later_ask}], a typed block, never a pass.
